title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Is adding Google Adsense in a website, and earn money through this Halaal? Google Adsense is actually an Advertisement platform, which is embedded in a website, which shows different sort of advertisement. Though they say that they dont show porn type of ads as per their policy, but there are other non shariah advertisements to be displayed. Though all the ads are not Non Shariah, but if talking about the non shariah ads displayed by Google Adsense,l some are the advertisements of Dating, Songs, Meat, Skulls, Christianity Promition, Adult Hosting, " You must be saved to go to Heaven" etc. But as said, all the advertisement are not non shariah and haraam only. Halaal ads are also displayed there. Now please look into this matter, and let us know if the income of such earning is Halaal or not, and if not Halaal then what action could be taken on that.. Question: Aswk Mufti Saab, I am from Bangalore-india and am 25 yrs of age and a great great fan of Maulana Tariq Jameel saheb and Maulana Anzar shah Qasmi. Because of the mercy of Allah and influence of above people i have decided to dedicate rest of my life in Dawa and Tableeque. I have few confusion\questions for you. 1.I work for American based company(MNC) and want to know if my earnings from American company is Halaal\Haraam.At this scenario of the world, can Momin work under American companies? 2.I work in a mixed environment(Men and Women), whats shariah ruling on this? 3.Few days back, before FAJR, i saw a dream where a man wearing Turban(white), having one fist beard sitting opposite to me and telling me laughing....what you will do in Tableeq, what talent you have to do Tabliq? Why do you want to offer rest of your life to Dawa and Tablique? Please help me with above questions and please pray that i spend rest of my life in the path of Allah(swt) May Allah guide us!!! Answer ID: 13425 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 855/666=L/1430) If you are doing a lawful work, your income is lawful and halal . A Muslim can do a lawful job in an American company. (2) While working in mixed environment, it is necessary to observe the Shariah limits like lowering the gaze, avoiding wanton and unrestrained talk to a strange woman etc. It is advisable for you to keep on looking for work in a company free from mixed environment and leave the present when you find a suitable one; since keeping oneself restrained in this environment and refraining from sins is very much difficult. (3) The person seen in the dream was Satan and he wanted you to leave Tableegh. You must not pay any heed to it and you should engage yourself in Tableegh more and more. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
